question: Which Part of the Constitution of India deals with the powers and functioning of the Supreme Court of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Part V.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Part V** of the Constitution of India deals with the** powers and functioning** of the** Union Judiciary,** which includes the **Supreme Court of India.**
 
• **Part VI **deals with the **powers and functioning** of the** High Courts** in the states.
 
• **Part X **deals with the The Scheduled and Tribal Area.
 
• **Part XI** deals with the relations between the** Union and the states.**
 
• Hence, the **correct** option is option 1 - Part V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** Constitution of India** is the **supreme law of India** that lays down the** framework for the governance** of the country.
 
• The** Supreme Court **of India is the **highest judicial forum **and **final court of appeal **in India.
